title: Rust: Trust Models implementation
description: Rust implementation of GCP-3 Trust Models in mesh-gateway: PSK federation mode with OSCORE, signature federation with Ed25519+Schnorr, TOFU/PKI trust establishment.
close_reason: Already done: rust/lichen-link/src/trust.rs (710 lines) + rust/lichen-gateway/src/trust.rs (1157 lines) implement GCP-3.1/3.2 trust models with TrustLevel enum, TOFU verification, key rotation, PskFederation, IID/DODAGID binding.
